subject: Onboarding MAP & Implementation Timeline — Zenith Retail
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Thomas <ava@zenithretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding MAP & Implementation Timeline — Zenith Retail

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a lean implementation timeline I put together for Zenith Retail. The goal is to capture the milestones, owners, and target dates so we can align the kickoff and the resources on both sides.

High-level milestones (see attachment for details):
- Kickoff / project initiation — target week of May 10
- Security questionnaire & evidence delivery — target May 14
- Test env provisioning & access validation — target May 21
- First integration sprint (embeddings + rerank) — May 24–June 4
- Pilot validation & acceptance — June 15

Please review the dates and owners in the attached "Zenith_MAP_v1.xlsx". A few asks for you:
1) Confirm your internal owner for SSO/KMS (we currently have Liam listed).
2) Flag any hard blackout dates for your rollout window.
3) Are you available for a 45-min kickoff next Tuesday (May 11) at 10am PT?

Next steps from our side: Marissa (CS lead) will take over the implementation planning after kickoff and will publish a sprint-by-sprint plan. Connor will coordinate the dedicated capacity request and initial environment sizing.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Zenith_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ava Thomas <ava@zenithretail.com>

Cc: Liam Porter <liam.porter@zenithretail.com>
Date: Fri, 01 May 2026 13:48:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Onboarding MAP & Implementation Timeline — Zenith Retail

Hannah —

Appreciate the clear plan and the spreadsheet. Quick notes from our side after a quick sync:
- Confirmed: Liam will be our internal owner for SSO/KMS and will coordinate with your team for key exchange.
- Security: we do have an internal SOC/security batch this month; can you confirm what minimum artifacts you can provide by May 14? (SOC 2 report, data retention policy, encryption at rest details)
- Timeline: the pilot acceptance window is tight for us — could we move the pilot validation from June 15 to June 22? That gives our product team one extra week for QA.

We can do the kickoff on Tue May 11 at 10am PT — that works for Liam and me. Please send calendar invite with dial-in.

Thanks,
Ava
Director, Product Integrations | Zenith Retail
ava@zenithretail.com

Hi Ava / Hannah —

Thanks for confirming the kickoff time. I've updated the timeline to shift pilot validation to June 22 as requested and added more granular milestones and owners. Attached: "Implementation_Timeline_v2.pdf" (lean one-pager plus sprint breakdown).

Summary of updated milestones and owners (short):
- Project kickoff & charter (Owner: Hannah) — May 11
- Security artifacts delivery (Owner: Hannah) — May 14 (SOC 2 summary, Data Retention doc, Encryption notes)
- Provisioning & access validation (Owner: Connor) — May 21
- Integration sprint 1 (Owner: Marissa / Eng Integration) — May 24–June 4
  - Deliverables: embeddings index, initial reranking tests, latency targets verified
- Integration sprint 2 (Owner: Marissa / Customer Eng) — June 7–June 18
  - Deliverables: end-to-end flow, edge-case prompts, monitoring hooks
- Pilot validation & acceptance (Owner: Zenith QA + Marissa) — June 22

Risk / dependencies:
- Security evidence turnaround — please confirm whether you need full SOC 2 report or a signed letter. If full report is required, we may need a short PO / NDA process to release.
- SSO/KMS key exchange — Connor will reach out to Liam for the KMS setup; please expect a questionnaire.

Action items before kickoff (May 11):
1) Hannah: send calendar invite + attendee list (done)
2) Ava / Liam: confirm whether a redacted SOC 2 summary suffices or if procurement requires the full report (reply by May 7)
3) Connor: open dedicated capacity sizing ticket and share initial IP allowlist requirements

Ava — if that looks good I can start drafting the sprint tickets and weekly check-ins cadence (30-min standups recommended).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: Implementation_Timeline_v2.pdf (PDF)
